title: Sidecar: ask the talk anything (live pitch)
abstract: The Sidecar team demos live captions, private questions answered from what the speaker just said, and introductions between people stuck on the same problem.
speaker: Team Sidecar

title: OpenTelemetry at Scale: Sampling Without Losing the Interesting Traces
abstract: We run 200 services and our tracing bill tripled. This talk walks through moving from head-based to tail-based sampling in the OpenTelemetry Collector, keeping every error and slow trace while dropping most healthy ones, plus how we sized collector memory so it stopped OOMing.
speaker: Maya Okafor

title: eBPF for Runtime Security, Explained From Zero
abstract: What eBPF actually is, why every security vendor suddenly uses it, and how to read a simple program that detects a container spawning a shell. No kernel experience needed.
speaker: Daniel Reyes

title: Golden Paths That Developers Actually Take
abstract: Our internal developer platform had a beautiful template nobody used. We share the interviews, the three changes that tripled adoption, and the metrics we now track for platform health.
speaker: Priya Natarajan

title: Cutting LLM Inference Latency on Kubernetes by 60%
abstract: Batching, KV-cache aware routing and GPU bin-packing for self-hosted models. Real numbers from a production chat assistant, including the autoscaling mistake that cost us a weekend.
speaker: Sam Lee

title: Tail Sampling Deep Dive: Policies, Memory and Load Balancing
abstract: A hands-on look at the tail sampling processor: writing policies for errors, latency and rare endpoints, why you need trace-ID aware load balancing in front of your collectors, and how to keep memory bounded.
speaker: Jonas Weber

title: GitOps Rollbacks Under Pressure
abstract: What happens when a bad release ships at 2am and your source of truth is git. Argo CD rollbacks, progressive delivery with canaries, and the runbook that saved our on-call team.
speaker: Lena Fischer

title: Your First Year in Cloud Native: A Map for Newcomers
abstract: Overwhelmed by the landscape? A friendly tour of the ten projects you'll hear about most, what problem each one solves, and where newcomers can contribute this month.
speaker: Aisha Bello

title: Running the OpenTelemetry Collector at a Million Spans per Second
abstract: Scaling collectors horizontally, trace-ID aware load balancing, memory limiter tuning and what our dashboards look like when it all works.
speaker: Ana Costa

title: SLOs From Traces: Turning Spans Into Error Budgets
abstract: How we generate RED metrics from spans before sampling and build SLOs that product teams actually read.
speaker: Ines Duarte

title: Autoscaling GPU Inference Without Cold Starts
abstract: Warm pools, predictive scaling and KEDA triggers for LLM serving on Kubernetes, with the latency numbers.
speaker: Mei Tanaka

title: Measuring Your Internal Developer Platform
abstract: DORA, adoption funnels and developer surveys: the five platform metrics our leadership actually asked for.
speaker: Omar Haddad

title: eBPF for Observability: Traces Without Code Changes
abstract: Using eBPF to capture HTTP and gRPC spans from any service, and where it beats SDK instrumentation.
speaker: Kim Park

title: Tracing LLM Apps: Tokens, Costs and Prompts You Can't Store
abstract: OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions, sampling prompts safely, and catching runaway token bills.
speaker: Sam Lee

title: GitOps for 300 Clusters
abstract: Argo CD app-of-apps, progressive delivery with Argo Rollouts, and how we stopped config drift.
speaker: Dev Rao

title: Your First Open Source Contribution in Cloud Native
abstract: Good first issues, how maintainers review, and the community meetings where newcomers are welcome.
speaker: Leo Martins
